parameters.name: EPNInstanceName
parameters.description: The name of the EPN instance.

parameters.name: EPNInstanceType
parameters.description: The type of the EPN instance. Set the value to **EdgeToEdge**.

parameters.name: InternetChargeType
parameters.description:
The billing method for network usage. Valid values:

- **BandwidthByDay**: Pay by daily peak bandwidth.

- **95BandwidthByMonth**: Pay by monthly 95th percentile bandwidth.

- **PayByBandwidth4thMonth**: Pay by monthly fourth peak bandwidth.

- **PayByBandwidth**: Pay by fixed bandwidth.

You can specify only one metering method for network usage and cannot overwrite the existing metering method.

parameters.name: InternetMaxBandwidthOut
parameters.description: The maximum outbound public bandwidth. Unit: Mbit/s. Valid values: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: NetworkingModel
parameters.description:
The networking mode. Valid values:

- **SpeedUp**: intelligent acceleration network (Internet)

- **Connection**: internal network

- **SpeedUpAndConnection**: intelligent acceleration network and internal network
